key_reasoning.reason: Four cooperating pieces inside the browser-test harness: the journey name registry and row pattern (journeys/shop.ts), the safety decision and runner (tidy/tidy.ts), the cross-schema row removal (tidy/remove.ts), and the Playwright global setup/teardown hooks, plus a new vitest config for their unit tests. Reuses the shared DEV_DATABASE_URL utility.

No existing precedent for destructive clean-up against a live local database. Risk handled by a local-only host guard (including pg host/hostaddr query overrides), an E2E_KEEP_DATA opt-out, a single transaction with rollback, parameterised regex matching, connection/statement timeouts, and never-reject warning handling so the tidy-up cannot change test outcomes. Edge-case tests exist (names, decision, removal) and the repo's table-style access tests serve as a template, so no further edge-case bump applied.

Diffstat reports 15 files (528 insertions, 38 deletions): roughly 7 new under tests/e2e/tidy plus vitest.config.ts, and 7 modified across tests/e2e, docs and .ai-run guides; 15 maps to XL on the actual-mode scale.
Issue #39 states a clear goal; the only design choices (local-only guard, opt-out flag, before-and-after timing) were settled in the implementation without visible rework.

calibration_note: Total 21 sits one above the M/L boundary. Bundled M example epmcdme-10203 (REST endpoint, 15) is smaller in file count and risk; this change's 15 files and destructive-data safety logic justify L. Borderline rule is neutral here (Technical Risk is L, not XL; not at or below M).
